newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl says he supports Romanian NATO bid.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says he supports Romanian NATO bid.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl saidon Wednesday he supported Romania's bid for NATO membership ahead of next week's alliance summit in Madrid.

"The Chancellor said... that the government and himself have a lot of sympathy for the Romanian desire for early NATO membership and support it," German government spokesman Peter Hausmann said in a statement.

The announcement came after Romanian President Emil Constantinescu met Kohl in Bonn in a last-ditch attempt to elicit support from Europe's largest NATO member, whose voice could be decisive in Madrid.
Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic are expected to be invited to join the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation at the summit in a first wave of enlargement.

While the United States wants to limit the first enlargement to the three favourites, many European NATO members want Slovenia and Romania included. Germany had remained officially non-committal on the issue until now.
